review_notes: Independently read both proposal artifacts and all cited canonical change/contradiction ranges. Both changes agree with functionality.md and canonical behavior; rendered hypotheses were not used as evidence. Supported retained knowledge is inherited unchanged, not independently re-audited.
unresolved: Accepted deferral: compiled section extents, ordering, padding and literal placement require compiled evidence.
Accepted deferral: trophy 275's Captain Olimar identity and corresponding concept links remain unverified.

proposed_facts.reason: The canonical call passes channel 0 separately from "01"; the callee explicitly receives company and game_name and copies two and four bytes respectively. The correction appropriately declines to establish compiled placement.

Canonical code confirms the low-byte zero guard, nested zero-result probe, ordered trophy calls and unconditional override installation and mode request. The preparatory callee lazily loads tables, excludes listed US entries, sets eligible category-2 flags and category bit 4. The functionality document preserves these branches without relying on rendered names.

contradictions.reason: Accept the unresolved dispositions for the .sbss layout and .sdata placement facts: source declarations and literals cannot establish compiled extents, ordering or padding. This also supports deferring the compiled-section portions of the .data/.sdata mapping claims and links.

Accept supersession of the slot-text purpose fact: "01" is the company identifier, not the channel. The same erroneous wording in link:6eeaa650-a18f-4006-834b-c3d65af661d1 is explicitly acknowledged by its inherited unresolved disposition; that link is not accepted as verified.

Accept supersession of the trophy state-behavior fact: a low-byte query is distinct from the separate flag queries, and the preparatory routine has concrete category-2 initialization behavior rather than unspecified synchronization.

Accept deferral of all four Captain Olimar mapping facts and all four concept links. The enum identifies trophy 275 as TROPHY_PIKMIN, and the registered callback probes a Pikmin filename on channel 0. These ranges establish the mechanism but not the exact character identity or the broader same-card narrative. Preserve those inherited claims as unverified, not disproved.
